teacher_moves: Name the object and observer before writing a velocity.
Combine the launcher's ground velocity with the object's velocity relative to the launcher before using projectile equations.
After release, use the combined ground-frame components on one projectile clock.
learner_surface.worked_example: A platform moves east at 4 m/s while a ball is projected east at 7 m/s relative to the platform. Find the ball's horizontal launch velocity in the ground frame and explain why the velocities add.
learner_surface.faded_task: A cart moves east at 5 m/s. A ball is projected at 10 m/s relative to the cart, with relative components 8 m/s east and 6 m/s up. Set up the ground-frame launch components; complete the vector addition yourself.
learner_surface.independent_task: A trolley moves west at 3 m/s. A ball is projected relative to the trolley with components 8 m/s east and 6 m/s up. Find the ground-frame launch components, state when Galilean velocity addition applies, and check the zero-trolley-speed limit.
